private_note: Still just my income: Cedar 122, Today 108, Alder 106, Birch 90, Hazel 86. Cedar is blocked: delegates 2, 4, 7, 8 and 11 won't touch it, so it can't reach 9. statement: Thank you all for being plain about your interests. I'll do the same. The straw poll shows Cedar at seven, but five delegates have said they will never back it, so I accept that it probably can't reach nine. I'm still ranking it first because it's best for my household. I've heard several of you name Alder as the meeting point, and I understand why. But I have to be honest: Alder leaves the fourth fifth below where we are today, 106 against 108, every year for a generation. Today's arrangements are the fallback, and for a household like mine, failure isn't a loss. So for now I rank today's arrangements above Alder, and Birch and Hazel below both. I'm not trying to block anyone for sport. If anyone sees a way to make a compromise leave the fourth fifth at least whole, I'm listening.
